technical_and_design_decisions: Target Spring Framework 6.x baseline with Java 17+ as minimum runtime.
Migrate Spring XD modules (Cassandra sink, PMML processor) to Spring Cloud Stream (s-c-s) 4.x using functional programming model (java.util.Function) and Spring Cloud Function.
Implement multi-binder support for same binding type via Spring Cloud Stream's binder selection mechanism (spring.cloud.stream.bindings.<name>.binder).

HDFS HA support: use Hadoop's NameNodeProxies.createProxy with HA configuration (dfs.nameservices, dfs.ha.namenodes.<nameservice>) instead of createNonHAProxy; integrate with Spring Hadoop / Spring Boot auto-configuration.

Job composition REST endpoints: extend Spring Cloud Data Flow's JobExecutionResource and JobExecutionResourceAssembler to include composition flag and graph; leverage existing JobExplorer and JobRepository.
UI changes: update Spring Cloud Data Flow UI (Angular/TypeScript) to consume new REST fields and render visual differentiation (icons, badges) and navigation to detail pages.
Maintain backward compatibility with existing Spring XD module configurations where feasible; provide migration guide.
Use Maven multi-module structure; each migrated module becomes a separate Spring Cloud Stream starter (spring-cloud-starter-stream-sink-cassandra, spring-cloud-starter-stream-processor-pmml).
Testing: contract tests for binder selection, integration tests with Testcontainers for Cassandra and HDFS HA, Spring Cloud Data Flow server integration tests for job composition endpoints.
assumptions: Development team has 2+ years experience with Spring Cloud Stream, Spring Cloud Data Flow, and Hadoop ecosystem.
Existing Spring XD module codebases (cassandra, analytic-pmml) are available and can be refactored rather than rewritten from scratch.
Spring Cloud Data Flow server version 2.11.x (compatible with Spring Boot 3.2 / Spring Framework 6.1) is the target platform.
HDFS HA configuration is provided via standard Hadoop configuration files (core-site.xml, hdfs-site.xml) on classpath or via Spring Boot properties.
UI work is limited to Spring Cloud Data Flow Dashboard (Angular 17+); no separate UI repository.
No changes required to Spring Framework core; all work is in Spring Cloud Stream, Spring Cloud Data Flow, and Spring Hadoop modules.
Effort estimates are for a single developer; no parallelization or team overhead included.
Documentation updates (reference docs, migration guides) are included in each feature's estimate.
Code review and CI/CD pipeline adjustments are included in each activity.
No performance tuning or load testing beyond basic integration tests.

activities.activity_description: Set up development workspace, clone Spring Cloud Stream, Spring Cloud Data Flow, Spring Hadoop repos; configure Maven, JDK 17, Testcontainers, Hadoop mini-cluster for HDFS HA testing; create feature branches.

activities.activity_name: Design and Specification for Multi-Binder Support (U1)
activities.activity_description: Analyze Spring Cloud Stream binder selection mechanism; design configuration model for multiple external systems per binding type; write design doc and update reference documentation.

activities.activity_name: Implement Multi-Binder Support for Same Binding Type (U1)
activities.activity_description: Modify BindingService and BinderFactory to allow multiple binders per binding name; add binder property 'spring.cloud.stream.bindings.<name>.binder'; implement routing logic; add unit and integration tests.

activities.activity_name: HDFS HA Support for Custom Module Location (U2)
activities.activity_description: Update Spring Hadoop's HdfsResourceLoader and related classes to use NameNodeProxies.createProxy with HA config; add auto-configuration for HA namenodes; write integration test with Testcontainers HDFS HA cluster.

activities.activity_name: Migrate Cassandra Sink Module to Spring Cloud Stream (U3)
activities.activity_description: Refactor spring-xd-module-cassandra into spring-cloud-starter-stream-sink-cassandra: convert to functional sink (Consumer<Message<?>>), use CassandraTemplate, add binder-agnostic configuration, publish as Maven artifact; write integration test with Testcontainers Cassandra.

activities.activity_name: Migrate Analytic PMML Processor Module to Spring Cloud Stream (U4)
activities.activity_description: Refactor spring-xd-module-analytic-pmml into spring-cloud-starter-stream-processor-pmml: implement Function<Message<?>, Message<?>> using JPMML-Evaluator, support PMML model loading from classpath/URL, add configuration properties; write integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Design Job Composition REST API Extensions (U5, U6)
activities.activity_description: Design REST API additions: add 'compositionFlag' field to JobExecutionResource; new endpoint '/jobs/executions/{id}/composition-graph' returning DAG of parent-child job executions; define JSON schema; update OpenAPI spec.

Extend JobExecutionResourceAssembler to compute composition flag (true if job execution has parent or children); modify JobExecutionRepository query to fetch relationships efficiently; add unit and integration tests.

Create new controller method to build composition graph: traverse JobExecution parent/child relationships via JobExplorer; return nodes and edges JSON; handle cycles, large graphs; add pagination; write integration tests with Spring Cloud Data Flow server.

activities.activity_name: UI Visual Differentiation for Job Composition vs Single Job (U7)
activities.activity_description: Update Spring Cloud Data Flow Dashboard: modify Job List and Job Execution components to show badge/icon based on compositionFlag; add CSS/styles; ensure accessibility; write Cypress e2e tests.

activities.activity_name: UI Navigation to Job Detail Page for Composed and Standalone Jobs (U8)
activities.activity_description: Enhance job execution row click handler to navigate to detail page regardless of composition type; pass job execution ID and composition context; update detail page to show parent/child links; write Cypress e2e tests.

activities.activity_name: Cross-Cutting Integration Testing and End-to-End Validation
activities.activity_description: Run full Spring Cloud Data Flow acceptance test suite with new modules; validate multi-binder scenarios, HDFS HA module deployment, Cassandra sink and PMML processor in streaming pipelines, job composition REST endpoints and UI flows; fix defects.

activities.activity_name: Documentation, Migration Guides, and Release Preparation
activities.activity_description: Update reference documentation for multi-binder, HDFS HA, new starters; write migration guide from Spring XD modules; update release notes; prepare Maven Central deployment; verify license headers and NOTICE files.

activities.activity_name: Code Review, Refactoring, and Technical Debt Cleanup
activities.activity_description: Address code review feedback across all pull requests; refactor duplicated code; improve test coverage to >80% for new code; update dependencies; run static analysis (SpotBugs, Checkstyle).
